Property.name: ResponseTimeout
Property.Description: Number of seconds to wait for a response to begin arriving back from the remote system after sending a request. Setting the timeout to -1 means wait forever.

Method.name: HL7Message
Method.Description: Accepts HL7 Messages and forwards them to a remote IP address, reading a response HL7 Message object returned from the remote IP address if the GetReply setting property is enabled.
Method.Implementation:
Set tSC = $$$OK $$$LOGINFO("ITFCOMMON.Tux.OutboundAdapter HL7Message to " _ ..ServiceName) $$$LOGINFO("Data: " _ pMsgOut.RawContent) #dim jmsgateway As EnsLib.JavaGateway.JavaGateway set jmsgateway = "" try { Set jmsgateway=##class(EnsLib.JavaGateway.JavaGateway).%New() Set classPath=##class(%ListOfDataTypes).%New() $$$LOGINFO("To connect")
Do classPath.Insert(..JMSJarPath) $$$LOGINFO("JMS Call Path added: " _ ..JMSJarPath) Set tStat=jmsgateway.%Connect(..JavaGateWayHost,..JavaGateWayPort,$NAMESPACE,5,classPath) If 'tStat { set tStat = $$$ISERR(status) set exp = ##class(%Exception.General).%New() set exp.Code = status.Name set exp.Data = status.Data set exp.Name = "Java Gateway connection error" Throw exp } $$$LOGINFO("Connected to Java Gateway: " _ ..JavaGateWayHost) set tuxServ = ##class(IHC.ITF.HL7RecordToTuxService).%New(jmsgateway, ..ApplicationHost, ..ServiceName) $$$LOGINFO("Connected to IHC.ITF.SendHl7RecordToTuxService: " _ tuxServ) set retStr = tuxServ.SendHl7MsgToService(pMsgOut.RawContent) $$$LOGINFO("Ack from Service: " _ retStr) Set pMsgIn = ##class(EnsLib.HL7.Message).ImportFromString(retStr)
Do jmsgateway.%Disconnect()
} catch err { if $GET(%objlasterror) '= "" { set errMsg = $System.Status.GetErrorText(%objlasterror) } else { set errMsg = "No obj" } $$$LOGALERT("Exception: Name: " _ err.Name _ " / Location:" _ err.Location _ " / Data: " _err.Data _ " / Details: " _ errMsg) Set tSC=$$$ERROR($$$GeneralError, err.Name _ " / Location:" _ err.Location _ " / Data: " _err.Data _ " " _ errMsg) if (jmsgateway '= "") { Do jmsgateway.%Disconnect() } } Quit tSC
